name: Oneshota Machi no Ecchi na Natsuyasumi
original_name: おねショタ町のえっちな夏休み
source:
Oneeshota Town, a not-so-prosperous and not-so-rural town.
The hero, Shota, is a teen boy living in this town.
Ever since his best friend "Takeru" showed him porno before the summer vacation,
he has been feeling restless.

That's how their summer vacation started.
Neighbour Oneechan, Gyaru, clumsy student council president, friend's mom...
Shota is surrounded by charming women.

How will an innocent boy, who has just started showing interest in sex, spend his summer...?
